newsitem.title: THAILAND: TPI Polene gets loan from Kreditanstalt.
newsitem.headline: TPI Polene gets loan from Kreditanstalt.

text.p: Thailand's TPI Polene Plc said on Wednesday it had signed a long term 4.49 billion baht loan contract with Germany's Kreditanstalt fuer Wiederaufbau (KfW) to finance the purchase of machines for its new cement plant.

The loan would be used to buy machines and engineering design works from two German firms -- Krupp AG Hoesch-Krupp unit Krupp Polysius GmbH AG and Projektall Industrieberatung GmbH, TPI Polene said in a statement to the Thai stock exchange.
The loan was worth 85 percent of the total value of machines and design works contracted for purchase from the two firms.

Under the terms of a contract with Kreditanstalt, the loan would mature in 13 years and be paid in U.S. dollars with constant interest rate for the whole period, it added without giving details of the interest rate.
TPI Polene said the cement plant, its fourth, would have a production capacity of 8,500 tonnes per day and was expected to operate commercially at the end of 1998 or in early 1999.
